verdict.rationale: Mem0 applies AI to stored data: it extracts individual facts from conversations, auto-organizes memories into a graph, and answers entity-centric natural-language questions like "what do we know about Alice?". These are AI-derived views of the user's data, but they are retrieval primitives for agents, not insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside the product. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or summaries surfaced in the dashboard, proactive suggestions from memory data, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of such a feature.
